## Steps

1. Open this file; run `<A-2>` — sidebar shows 8 links.
2. Move to line 8 (`[[targets/alpha#Section Two]]`); sidebar follows.
3. Press `gD` — right viewport opens alpha.md at Section Two; gutter connects.
4. Press `<CR>` in sidebar on another row — toggle open/close embed.
5. Press `q` — closes Xanadu panels.
